apps.subtitle: Mod by Leviidev
apps.localizedDescription:
Run Android apps and games on your iPhone!
This is an open source app that lets you run Android apps and games on iOS using an ARM64 translation layer or full Android emulation via QEMU. Supports APKs, XAPKs, APKMs, controllers, and various game engines. Requires iOS 16.4+ and JIT.
